name: pgbully
abstract: Distributed leader election for PostgreSQL using the Bully algorithm
description: pgBully turns a set of PostgreSQL nodes into a cluster that always agrees on a single leader. Each node runs a background worker that exchanges heartbeat and election messages with its peers over libpq, continuously running the classic Bully leader-election algorithm: the reachable node with the highest id wins, and failover to the next-highest node is automatic. No external coordinator is required.
